pricing_faq.question: How do tokens work?
pricing_faq.answer: Tokens are consumed based on the content types you create in one content creation run: Script generation: 5 tokens, Images: 10 tokens per scene, Voiceovers: 5 tokens per scene, Background music: 20 tokens, Video assembly: 20 tokens, Animations: 30 tokens per scene (Premium feature), Video scenes: 50 tokens per scene (Premium feature).

pricing_faq.question: Can I change plans anytime?
pricing_faq.answer: Yes! You can upgrade, downgrade, or cancel your subscription at any time. Unused tokens from packages never expire.

pricing_faq.question: What happens if I exceed my token limit?
pricing_faq.answer: Your account won't be charged automatically. You can either upgrade your plan or purchase additional token packages to continue creating or you can wait until the next monthly reset.

pricing_faq.question: Do unused monthly tokens roll over?
pricing_faq.answer: Yes, each monthly token allocation is rolled over if not used. Also, tokens from one-time packages never expire.
